attributes.board_name: Wisconsin Physical Therapy Examining Board (Department of Safety and Professional Services)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved continuing education providers and activities listed in Wis. Admin. Code PT 9.04.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE is not required during the biennium in which the license was first issued.

topics.who: At least 4 of the 30 contact hours in ethics and jurisprudence

rules.notes: Biennial reporting period March 1 of an odd-numbered year through February 28 of the next odd-numbered year (e.g. Mar 1, 2025 - Feb 28, 2027). The Board has a 2026 scope statement to review ch. PT 9 (approval and credit rules may change).
rules.rule_quote: (1) Unless granted a postponement or waiver under sub. (8), every physical therapist shall complete at least 30 hours of board-approved continuing education in each biennial registration period, as specified in s. 448.55 (3), Stats.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved continuing education per Wis. Admin. Code PT 9.04.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE is not required for the first renewal.

topics.who: 4 of the 20 contact hours in ethics and jurisprudence

rules.notes: Biennium March 1 of an odd-numbered year to February 28 of the next odd-numbered year.
rules.rule_quote: (2) Unless granted a postponement or waiver under sub. (8), every physical therapist assistant shall complete at least 20 hours of board-approved continuing education in each biennial registration period, as specified in s. 448.55 (3), Stats.
